Introduction

E.sha, formerly known as ChaeE, Yena and Kwon Jiyu, is a South Korean singer under BeBy Entertainment. She is the Leader, Main Dancer and Lead Vocalist of girl group X:in and a former member of the upcoming girl group MEP-C formed through the training platform Universe. She is also a former member of the girl groups Rusty.G, G-(i)Kon and LAONZENA.
